description: Agent Consent: submit the consent ledger entry a grant leaves behind and the events behind it: the entry with its id, who gave the consent, who it was given to, the data, actions, recipients and purposes it covers, when it was given and ends, how it was captured, the notice version shown, its status (active, narrowed, revoked or expired) and when the status was last updated; and each event with its id, when it happened, its kind (granted, narrowed, widened, renewed, revoked, expired or used), the data it concerns and who made it happen. The signed report gives the entry, every event in time order with its status as consistent, after_end, before_grant, not_by_principal or untimed, the standing the entry records beside the standing the events support with when the consent ended, and counts the events, uses, uses after the end, uses before the grant and untimed events, and names a ledger that does not hold the consent as it stands: no record of who gave it, to whom or when, a status that misses a withdrawal, an expiry or a narrowing, a use logged after the consent ended or before it was granted, data beyond what the grant events show the principal granting and a widening by someone other than the principal; then no grant event, a grant time that differs from it, a status with no event behind it, a status time older than the event that changed it, an untimed event and no purposes, capture method, notice version or status time, with the fix for each. A use after a withdrawal counts until a later grant or renewal. This reads the record one consent leaves behind: recording and evaluating wallet-scoped permission grants and revocations is wever_agent-permission-ledger, a system’s delegation records are wever_delegation-record-check and a mandate’s current state is wever_mandate-status. Verdict consent_record_missing, consent_record_incomplete, consent_record_unverifiable or consent_record_complete. POST /api/consent-record-check. Reads only the recorded consent material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no principal is contacted, no consent is requested, recorded, renewed or withdrawn and no data is used, moved or deleted. Agent Consent reads the grant the principal gave before the agent uses data or acts on it: whether the grant covers this use, whether it is still in force, whether it was withdrawn, whether the record proves it, what it was given for, whether the data may pass on and whether fresh consent is due. It is not the agent’s authority to act (wever_authority-scope-check reads an agent’s access list against the authority grant its operator gave it; a consent check reads the grant the principal gave over their own data: authority is not consent, and consent is not authority), not a mandate (the wever_mandate tools, wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-revoke and wever_mandate-draft, issue and change what an agent may trade or spend for a principal; a consent check reads what the principal agreed may be done with their data and changes nothing), not a data sample (wever_data-evidence-check reads a dataset sample’s fields and types; a consent check reads the permission behind using the data, not the data itself), not terms against a purchase (wever_terms-match-check reads purchases already made against their governing terms; a consent grant is the principal’s permission, not a seller’s terms), not a promise (the wever_commitment checks read what the agent promised; consent is what the principal granted, and an agent’s promise never stands in for it) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a consent check reads whether the principal’s grant allows the work at all). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-consent-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-consent/.

purposes.description: The purposes it was given for.

status.description: The status the entry shows: active, narrowed, revoked or expired.

status_at.description: When the status was last updated.

events.description: The consent events behind the entry, in any order.

by.description: Who made it happen, such as the principal, the agent or an operator.

id.description: The event id, such as v1.

kind.description: Granted, narrowed, widened, renewed, revoked, expired or used.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

name: wever_consent-record-check
title: Consent record check
